description: This file defines a template class RangeType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The class provides functionality for representing and manipulating a range of values of a generic type, including checking validity, range boundaries, and whether a value falls within the range.

classes.name: RangeType
classes.description: A template class that models a range of values with inclusive or exclusive bounds, providing methods for validation, range calculation, and containment checks.

methods.name: RangeType
methods.description: Default constructor initializing min and max to default values.

methods.name: RangeType
methods.description: Constructor initializing min and max to specified values.

methods.description: Assignment operator to copy range values.

methods.description: Equality comparison between two RangeType objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison between two RangeType objects.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the range is valid (min less than or equal to max).

methods.name: Range
methods.description: Calculates the size of the range considering inclusive/exclusive bounds.

methods.name: Minimum
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the range.

methods.name: Maximum
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the range.

methods.name: InRange
methods.description: Checks if a given value falls within the range bounds.
